title: analyze_opponent_argument skill — dissect the opponent's last message and decide what to rebut (Epic 4)
prompt:
Implement analyze_opponent_argument(...) that takes the opponent's last message, surfaces weaknesses/assumptions, and returns what to rebut. Validated inputs.

Follow repo standards: TDD (write the failing test first, then code); max 150 lines per code file (split, don't compress); ruff = 0 violations + mypy clean; no hard-coded values (read from config); every external API call goes through the API gatekeeper (Epic 13); log via the LOG package; keep coverage >= 85%. Read docs/PRD.md and the relevant docs/prds/*.md before starting.
note: Second agent skill of Epic 4 (PRD §5.2), mirroring build_argument (4.3). Added to the existing core/skills/ subpackage: skills/analyze_opponent.py (the function) + two new models in skills/models.py + re-exports from agent_debate.core.skills and agent_debate.core. INPUT model OpponentAnalysisRequest (frozen, extra='forbid'): side: DebateSide (StrEnum pro/con; bad value => ValidationError), opponent_message (non-empty after trim), weaknesses: list[str] (optional, default []; a field validator trims entries and drops blanks). OUTPUT model OpponentAnalysis (frozen, extra='forbid'): side, claims (key claims extracted from the message), weaknesses (as flagged), and a single prioritised rebuttal_target; round-trips through JSON. PURE/NO-NETWORK skill: analyze_opponent_argument deterministically STRUCTURES the agent-supplied content and makes NO LLM/network call — the LLM supplies the judgement as tool arguments, the skill arranges it — so the API gatekeeper (Epic 13) requirement is N/A here (noted per task). Claim extraction splits the message on sentence delimiters (CLAIM_SPLIT_DELIMITERS = '.!?' in constants.py — no hard-coded value inline). Anti-sycophancy (docs/prds/anti-sycophancy.md §2): rebuttal_target is ALWAYS a concrete point to attack — the first/strongest flagged weakness, or the opponent's lead claim when none were flagged — so the agent targets and rebuts, never concedes. Composability: rebuttal_target is a ready value for ArgumentRequest.opponent_point, asserted by an integration test that pipes analyze_opponent_argument into build_argument. FULL Pydantic AI tool registration is task 4.5 (not over-built here). TDD red-first: wrote packages/core/tests/test_analyze_opponent.py (12 tests: structured output, side reflected, flagged weaknesses prioritised as target, fallback to lead claim when no weaknesses, multi-sentence/consecutive-delimiter claim splitting, JSON round-trip, composes into build_argument's opponent_point, and ValidationError on empty/whitespace message, bad side enum, missing required field; plus blank-weakness normalisation), watched it fail (ImportError: cannot import name 'OpponentAnalysis'), then implemented to green. Gates green locally: uv sync clean; ruff check . = All checks passed; ruff format --check . clean; mypy = no issues in 87 source files; pytest --cov = 317 passed, 100% coverage on the new module, 100% total (>=85 required); check_line_limit.py rc=0 (analyze_opponent.py ~26 code lines, models additions well under 150); secret_scan.py rc=0. docs/PROMPTS.md entry added.
